report.name: rf_cmd_dispatch
report.purpose: RF subsystem command dispatcher / bus-reset routine that is shared between the WiFi (fmacfw) and Bluetooth (fmacfwbt) firmware images at the same load address. It dispatches a host-issued RF command, performing any required RF bus reset pre-amble (testing a 0x20000 status bit mask and continuing the reset sequence when set), and then sub-calls a peripheral RF handler. It belongs to the RF control plane that initialises / recovers the radio before channel/CAL operations.

parameters.name: rf_cmd
parameters.purpose: RF command opcode / selector that determines which sub-handler to invoke and which reset path to take

parameters.name: rf_arg
parameters.purpose: Command argument / context pointer passed through to the sub-dispatched RF handler

return_value.meaning: 0 on successful dispatch / reset completion, negative on RF bus error or unrecognised command

side_effects: Reads RF controller status register (0x20000 bit-mask tested, indicating a status/poll MMIO in the RF register page)
Writes RF controller command/reset register to drive the reset sequence
May assert/deassert RF bus enable / clock gate bits in the RF MMIO page
Invokes a sub-dispatched RF handler which performs additional MMIO writes
key_callees: rf_sub_handler_dispatch (sub-call invoked after reset / status validation, name not resolvable from the available tool output)
rf_bus_reset_sequence (reset continuation path, behavioural alias: rf_bus_reset2_n236)
key_callers: rf_top_init / rf_top_cmd_entry (RF top-level command entry, per the behavioural 'rf_cmd_dispatch' caller list returned by find_callers)
bt_rf_init_coex (Bluetooth-side RF init path that also links to rf_cmd_dispatch)
mac_rf_recover (MAC recovery handler that re-arms the RF bus via this dispatcher)
report.summary: Shared RF command dispatcher / 0x20000-mask-checked bus-reset helper common to both WiFi (fmacfw) and Bluetooth (fmacfwbt) 8800D80 firmware images.
